feedback_driven.quote: adapt by rewriting their own harness, such as prompts, memory, and skills, from task feedback while the model weights stay frozen

persists_across_tasks.quote: apply global edits to a shared prompt or workspace, interfering with unseen tasks and overwriting earlier knowledge as the stream shifts

data.why_zh: 冻结权重下自进化智能体改写提示/记忆/技能并跨任务保留，属harness演化
